grammar: Word order: object, subject, verb. With one participant: subject, verb.
Plural: say the noun twice (mekatu → mekatu-mekatu).
Past tense. Without it the verb is present or future.
On the verb when the subject is plural.
explain.notes: Checked against 896 alternative analyses; the sentences rule out 893, including: full reduplication appears when: plural & past; -pi appears when: (past or plural lone-subject/object); se- appears when: (negative or plural object).
